title: Figure 17: Progress in Tokamak Magnetic Confinement Fusion
description: Left: log-scale plot of a fusion performance parameter versus IPA (MA), with a diagonal trend through labeled devices from T3 (ca 1970) and START through ST, W7-AS, NSTX, PLT, LHD, TFTR DT (1998) and JET DT (1998) to ITER-EDA and ITER in the 'Burning Plasma Regime', with a fusion gain (Q) scale. Right: scaled cross sections of D-shaped tokamak plasmas for COMPASS-D, ASDEX-U, JET and ITER versus major radius (m), captioned 'Cross section of present EU D-shape tokamaks compared to the ITER project'.
